author: Michal238
text: Yes,you are right. Blue CPPAZ was not broken. I was considering scenario what would happen if price broke into it. When price breaks into CP PAZ there will be retrace before it goes to the other side.. We don't know in advance where price stops. It can retrace a little bit and go to the other side of CP PAZ, or it can retrace some more. But it cant break into new PAZ which is above.
